title: Better To Ask in English? Evaluating Factual Accuracy of Multilingual LLMs in English and Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with identical factual questions in English and 19 low-resource Indic languages from the IndicQuest dataset, and evaluating the performance disparities using an automated LLM judge (scoring factual accuracy, relevance, clarity, consistency, and conciseness) as well as reference-based metrics like F1 and ROUGE-L.
